invariants.rationale: expandIcon is dereferenced to call draw and getMinWidth/getMinHeight, so it must be non-null.
batch is passed to expandIcon.draw and thus must be non-null.
Drawable's minimum width is typically non-negative, especially since it is used as a width in draw.
Drawable's minimum height is typically non-negative and used as a height in draw.
The node is a generic parameter representing a tree node and is likely required and non-null for meaningful use.
